title: Spire Respiration Log Breaths per Minute Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spire:breath breaths_per_min=*
| stats sum(breaths_per_min) as total_value, avg(breaths_per_min) as avg_value by context
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks context values by total and average breaths per minute across Spire respiration log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `breaths_per_min` values for each Spire respiration log event and review total and average breaths per minute by context.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total breaths per minute.
grandmaExplanation: It fairly which context shows the biggest breaths per minute numbers in your Spire respiration log data.
